decision_points.condition: UE in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state and needs to register for 5GS services, emergency services, SMS over NAS, moves from GERAN/UTRAN to NG-RAN, performs initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN, performs initial registration for disaster roaming services, or performs initial registration to come out of unavailability period and resume normal services

outcomes.outcome: Success - REGISTRATION REQUEST sent, timers started
outcomes.next_step: AMF receives REGISTRATION REQUEST

outcomes.outcome: Failure - UE already registered for emergency services over non-current access
outcomes.next_step: UE does not initiate registration (unless handover of emergency PDU session is needed)

outcomes.outcome: Failure - UE cannot register for emergency services over 3GPP access
outcomes.next_step: UE attempts registration for emergency services over non-3GPP access

decision_points.condition: Initial registration request is accepted by the network

outcomes.outcome: Success - REGISTRATION ACCEPT sent
outcomes.next_step: UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT

outcomes.outcome: Failure - Initial registration request cannot be accepted by the network
outcomes.next_step: AMF sends REGISTRATION REJECT

decision_points.condition: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the LADN indication IE

outcomes.outcome: LADN indication IE includes requested LADN DNNs, UE subscribed DNN list includes the requested LADN DNNs or the wildcard DNN, and the LADN service area of the requested LADN DNN has an intersection with the current registration area
outcomes.next_step: AMF determines the requested LADN DNNs included in the LADN indication IE as LADN DNNs for the UE

outcomes.outcome: No requested LADN DNNs included in the LADN indication IE and the wildcard DNN is included in the UE subscribed DNN list
outcomes.next_step: AMF determines the LADN DNN(s) configured in the AMF whose LADN service area has an intersection with the current registration area as LADN DNNs for the UE

outcomes.outcome: No requested LADN DNNs included in the LADN indication IE and the wildcard DNN is not included in the UE subscribed DNN list, or if the UE subscribed DNN list does not include any of the DNN's in the LADN indication IE
outcomes.next_step: AMF determines the LADN DNN(s) included in the UE subscribed DNN list whose LADN service area has an intersection with the current registration area as LADN DNNs for the UE

decision_points.condition: LADN indication IE is not included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message

outcomes.outcome: LADN indication IE is not included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message
outcomes.next_step: AMF determines the LADN DNN(s) included in the UE subscribed DNN list whose service area has an intersection with the current registration area as LADN DNNs for the UE, except for the wildcard DNN included in the UE subscribed DNN list

decision_points.condition: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the Network slicing indication IE with the Network slicing subscription change indication set to 'Network slicing subscription changed' or a Configured NSSAI IE with a new configured NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN and optionally the mapped S-NSSAI(s) for the configured NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN or an NSSRG information IE with a new NSSRG information or an Alternative NSSAI IE with a new alternative NSSAI or an S-NSSAI location validity information in the Registration accept type 6 IE container IE with a new S-NSSAI location validity information or an S-NSSAI time validity information IE with a new S-NSSAI time validity information or an On-demand NSSAI IE with a new on-demand NSSAI or an updated slice deregistration inactivity timer value

outcomes.outcome: Success - REGISTRATION COMPLETE message sent
outcomes.next_step: AMF receives REGISTRATION COMPLETE

outcomes.outcome: Failure - UE does not send REGISTRATION COMPLETE message
outcomes.next_step: UE does not acknowledge the successful update of the network slicing information

decision_points.condition: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE and the UE had set the CAG bit to 'CAG supported' in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message

outcomes.outcome: Success - UE replaces the 'CAG information list' stored in the UE with the received CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE when received in the HPLMN or EHPLMN
outcomes.next_step: UE stores the received CAG information

outcomes.outcome: Success - UE replaces the serving VPLMN's entry of the 'CAG information list' stored in the UE with the serving VPLMN's entry of the received CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE when the UE receives the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE in a serving PLMN other than the HPLMN or EHPLMN
outcomes.next_step: UE stores the received CAG information

outcomes.outcome: Success - UE removes the serving VPLMN's entry of the 'CAG information list' stored in the UE when the UE receives the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE in a serving PLMN other than the HPLMN or EHPLMN and the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE does not contain the serving VPLMN's entry
outcomes.next_step: UE stores the received CAG information

decision_points.condition: The received 'CAG information list' includes an entry containing the identity of the registered PLMN

outcomes.outcome: UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message via a CAG cell, none of the CAG-ID(s) supported by the current CAG cell is authorized based on the 'Allowed CAG list' of the entry for the registered PLMN in the received 'CAG information list', and the entry for the registered PLMN in the received 'CAG information list' does not include an 'indication that the UE is only allowed to access 5GS via CAG cells'
outcomes.next_step: UE enters the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and shall search for a suitable cell according to 3GPP TS 38.304 [28] or 3GPP TS 36.304 [25C] with the updated 'CAG information list'

outcomes.outcome: UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message via a CAG cell, none of the CAG-ID(s) supported by the current CAG cell is authorized based on the 'Allowed CAG list' of the entry for the registered PLMN in the received 'CAG information list', and the entry for the registered PLMN in the received 'CAG information list' includes an 'indication that the UE is only allowed to access 5GS via CAG cells' and one or more CAG-ID(s) are authorized based on the 'Allowed CAG list' of the entry for the registered PLMN in the received 'CAG information list'
outcomes.next_step: UE enters the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and shall search for a suitable cell according to 3GPP TS 38.304 [28] with the updated 'CAG information list'

outcomes.outcome: UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message via a CAG cell, none of the CAG-ID(s) supported by the current CAG cell is authorized based on the 'Allowed CAG list' of the entry for the registered PLMN in the received 'CAG information list', and the entry for the registered PLMN in the received 'CAG information list' includes an 'indication that the UE is only allowed to access 5GS via CAG cells' and no CAG-ID is authorized based on the 'Allowed CAG list' of the entry for the registered PLMN in the received 'CAG information list', the UE has not set the 5GS registration type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message to 'emergency registration', and the initial registration was not initiated to perform handover of an existing emergency PDU session from the non-current access to the current access
outcomes.next_step: UE enters the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH and shall apply the PLMN selection process defined in 3GPP TS 23.122 [5] with the updated 'CAG information list'

outcomes.outcome: UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message via a non-CAG cell and the entry for the registered PLMN in the received 'CAG information list' includes an 'indication that the UE is only allowed to access 5GS via CAG cells' and one or more CAG-ID(s) are authorized based on the 'allowed CAG list' for the registered PLMN in the received 'CAG information list'
outcomes.next_step: UE enters the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and shall search for a suitable cell according to 3GPP TS 38.304 [28] with the updated 'CAG information list'

outcomes.outcome: UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message via a non-CAG cell and the entry for the registered PLMN in the received 'CAG information list' includes an 'indication that the UE is only allowed to access 5GS via CAG cells' and no CAG-ID is authorized based on the 'Allowed CAG list' of the entry for the registered PLMN in the received 'CAG information list', the UE has not set the 5GS registration type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message to 'emergency registration', and the initial registration was not initiated to perform handover of an existing emergency PDU session from the non-current access to the current access
outcomes.next_step: UE enters the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH and shall apply the PLMN selection process defined in 3GPP TS 23.122 [5] with the updated 'CAG information list'

decision_points.condition: The received 'CAG information list' does not include an entry containing the identity of the registered PLMN and the UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message via a CAG cell

outcomes.outcome: The received 'CAG information list' does not include an entry containing the identity of the registered PLMN and the UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message via a CAG cell
outcomes.next_step: UE enters the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and shall search for a suitable cell according to 3GPP TS 38.304 [28] or 3GPP TS 36.304 [25C] with the updated 'CAG information list'

decision_points.condition: the UE's USIM is configured with indication that the UE is to receive the SOR transparent container IE

outcomes.outcome: the SOR transparent container IE included in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message does not successfully pass the integrity check
outcomes.next_step: the UE shall locally release the established N1 NAS signalling connection after sending a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message

outcomes.outcome: the SOR transparent container IE is not included in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message
outcomes.next_step: the UE shall locally release the established N1 NAS signalling connection

decision_points.condition: the UE operates in SNPN access operation mode and the ME is configured to indicate that the UE shall expect to receive the steering of roaming information during initial registration procedure for the selected entry of the 'list of subscriber data' or the selected PLMN subscription

outcomes.outcome: the SOR transparent container IE included in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message does not successfully pass the integrity check
outcomes.next_step: the UE shall locally release the established N1 NAS signalling connection after sending a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message

outcomes.outcome: the SOR transparent container IE is not included in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message
outcomes.next_step: the UE shall locally release the established N1 NAS signalling connection

decision_points.condition: the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message includes the SOR transparent container IE and the SOR transparent container IE successfully passes the integrity check

outcomes.outcome: the registration procedure is performed over 3GPP access and the UE attempts obtaining service on another PLMNs or SNPNs as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122 [5] annex C
outcomes.next_step: the UE may locally release the established N1 NAS signalling connection after sending a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message

outcomes.outcome: otherwise
outcomes.next_step: the UE shall send a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message and not release the current N1 NAS signalling connection locally

decision_points.condition: the SOR transparent container IE successfully passes the integrity check

outcomes.outcome: the list type indicates 'PLMN ID and access technology list', and the SOR transparent container IE indicates a list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations is provided
outcomes.next_step: the ME shall replace the highest priority entries in the 'Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology' list stored in the ME and shall proceed with the behaviour as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122 [5] annex C

outcomes.outcome: the list type indicates 'secured packet'
outcomes.next_step: the ME shall behave as if a SMS is received with protocol identifier set to SIM data download, data coding scheme set to class 2 message and SMS payload as secured packet contents of SOR transparent container IE. The SMS payload is forwarded to UICC as specified in 3GPP TS 23.040 [4A] and the ME shall proceed with the behaviour as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122 [5] annex C

outcomes.outcome: the list type indicates 'PLMN ID and access technology list' and the SOR transparent container IE indicates 'HPLMN indication that 'no change of the 'Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology' list stored in the UE is needed and thus no list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations is provided'', the UE operates in SNPN access operation mode and the SOR transparent container IE includes SOR-SNPN-SI
outcomes.next_step: the ME shall replace SOR-SNPN-SI of the selected entry of the 'list of subscriber data' or associated with the selected PLMN subscription, as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122 [5] with the received SOR-SNPN-SI. Additionally, if the SOR transparent container IE includes SOR-SNPN-SI-LS, the ME shall replace SOR-SNPN-SI-LS of the selected entry of the 'list of subscriber data' or associated with the selected PLMN subscription, as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122 [5] with the received SOR-SNPN-SI-LS

decision_points.condition: the UE has set the Follow-on request indicator to 'Follow-on request pending' in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, or the network has downlink signalling pending

outcomes.outcome: the UE is configured for high priority access in the selected PLMN
outcomes.next_step: the AMF shall not immediately release the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the registration procedure

outcomes.outcome: the 5GS registration type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message is set to 'emergency registration'
outcomes.next_step: the AMF shall not immediately release the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the registration procedure

outcomes.outcome: otherwise
outcomes.next_step: the AMF shall not immediately release the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the registration procedure

decision_points.condition: the REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #76 or #78 was received without integrity protection

outcomes.outcome: the REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #76 or #78 was received without integrity protection
outcomes.next_step: the UE shall discard the message

decision_points.condition: the initial registration request is rejected because all the S-NSSAI(s) included in the requested NSSAI are rejected

outcomes.outcome: the UE set the NSSAA bit in the 5GMM capability IE to 'Network slice-specific authentication and authorization supported' and all default S-NSSAIs are not allowed
outcomes.next_step: the network shall set the 5GMM cause value of the REGISTRATION REJECT message to #62 'No network slices available'

outcomes.outcome: the UE set the NSSAA bit in the 5GMM capability IE to 'Network slice-specific authentication and authorization supported' and network slice-specific authentication and authorization has failed or been revoked for all default S-NSSAIs and based on network local policy, the network decides not to initiate the network slice-specific re-authentication and re-authorization procedures for any default S-NSSAI requested by the UE
outcomes.next_step: the network shall set the 5GMM cause value of the REGISTRATION REJECT message to #62 'No network slices available'

outcomes.outcome: the UE set the NSSAA bit in the 5GMM capability IE to 'Network slice-specific authentication and authorization not supported' and all default S-NSSAIs are either not allowed or are subject to network slice-specific authentication and authorization
outcomes.next_step: the network shall set the 5GMM cause value of the REGISTRATION REJECT message to #62 'No network slices available'

decision_points.condition: the AMF receives the initial registration request along with the authenticated indication over N2 reference point on non-3GPP access and does not receive the indication that authentication by the home network is not required over N12 reference point, or the 5G-RG acting on behalf of an AUN3 device is not allowed to access 5GS as specified in 3GPP TS 23.316 [6D]

outcomes.outcome: the AMF receives the initial registration request along with the authenticated indication over N2 reference point on non-3GPP access and does not receive the indication that authentication by the home network is not required over N12 reference point, or the 5G-RG acting on behalf of an AUN3 device is not allowed to access 5GS as specified in 3GPP TS 23.316 [6D]
outcomes.next_step: the network shall set the 5GMM cause value to #72 'Non-3GPP access to 5GCN not allowed'

decision_points.condition: the initial registration request from a UE supporting CAG is rejected due to CAG restrictions

outcomes.outcome: the initial registration request from a UE supporting CAG is rejected due to CAG restrictions
outcomes.next_step: the network shall set the 5GMM cause value to #76 'Not authorized for this CAG or authorized for CAG cells only' and should include the 'CAG information list' in the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE in the REGISTRATION REJECT message

decision_points.condition: the UE's initial registration request is via a satellite NG-RAN cell and the network using the User Location Information provided by the NG-RAN, see 3GPP TS 38.413 [31], is able to determine that the UE is in a location where the network is not allowed to operate

outcomes.outcome: the UE's initial registration request is via a satellite NG-RAN cell and the network using the User Location Information provided by the NG-RAN, see 3GPP TS 38.413 [31], is able to determine that the UE is in a location where the network is not allowed to operate
outcomes.next_step: the network shall set the 5GMM cause value in the REGISTRATION REJECT message to #78 'PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location'

decision_points.condition: the AMF receives the initial registration request including the service-level device ID set to the CAA-level UAV ID in the Service-level-AA container IE and the AMF determines that the UE is not allowed to use UAS services via 5GS based on the user's subscription data and the operator policy

outcomes.outcome: the AMF receives the initial registration request including the service-level device ID set to the CAA-level UAV ID in the Service-level-AA container IE and the AMF determines that the UE is not allowed to use UAS services via 5GS based on the user's subscription data and the operator policy
outcomes.next_step: the AMF shall return a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #79 'UAS services not allowed'

decision_points.condition: the UE initiates the registration procedure for disaster roaming services and the AMF determines that it does not support providing disaster roaming services for the determined PLMN with disaster condition to the UE

outcomes.outcome: the UE initiates the registration procedure for disaster roaming services and the AMF determines that it does not support providing disaster roaming services for the determined PLMN with disaster condition to the UE
outcomes.next_step: the AMF shall send a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #80 'Disaster roaming for the determined PLMN with disaster condition not allowed'

decision_points.condition: the AMF receives the initial registration request over non-3GPP access and detects that the N3IWF used by the UE is not compatible with the allowed NSSAI and the UE has indicated its support for slice-based N3IWF selection in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message

outcomes.outcome: the AMF receives the initial registration request over non-3GPP access and detects that the N3IWF used by the UE is not compatible with the allowed NSSAI and the UE has indicated its support for slice-based N3IWF selection in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message
outcomes.next_step: the AMF may send a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #81 'Selected N3IWF is not compatible with the allowed NSSAI' and may provide information for a suitable N3IWF in the REGISTRATION REJECT message indicating the suitable N3IWF that is compatible with the requested NSSAI

decision_points.condition: the AMF receives the initial registration request over non-3GPP access and detects that the TNGF used by the UE is not compatible with the allowed NSSAI and the UE has indicated its support for slice-based TNGF selection in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message

outcomes.outcome: the AMF receives the initial registration request over non-3GPP access and detects that the TNGF used by the UE is not compatible with the allowed NSSAI and the UE has indicated its support for slice-based TNGF selection in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message
outcomes.next_step: the AMF may send a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #82 'Selected TNGF is not compatible with the allowed NSSAI' and may provide information for a suitable TNAN in the TNAN information IE in the REGISTRATION REJECT message indicating the suitable TNGF that is compatible with the requested NSSAI

dependencies.reason: AMF can only receive the registration request if the UE initiates it.
UE can only receive REGISTRATION ACCEPT if the AMF accepts the registration request.
AMF can only send REGISTRATION REJECT if the AMF rejects the registration request.
UE sends REGISTRATION COMPLETE only if certain conditions are met after receiving REGISTRATION ACCEPT.
